title: Get bid protection statuses
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the current bid protection statuses for a list of Upgraded Smart+ Campaigns or Upgraded Smart+ Ad Groups. # Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/report/bid_protection/status/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/marketing-api-authentication/v1.3). | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID.| |data_level {Required}|string|The data level you want to query.

Enum values:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: Campaign level.
  • `ADGROUP`: Ad group level.
| |query_ids {Required}|string[]|The list of IDs you want to query.

Max size: 200.
  • When `data_level` is `CAMPAIGN`, specify a list of Upgraded Smart+ Campaign IDs.
    • To retrieve these IDs, use [/smart_plus/campaign/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-upgraded-smart-campaigns/v1.3).
  • When `data_level` is `ADGROUP`, specify a list of Upgraded Smart+ Ad Group IDs.
    • To retrieve these IDs, use [/smart_plus/adgroup/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-upgraded-smart-ad-groups/v1.3).

All IDs must belong to the same advertiser.| ``` ## Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/report/bid_protection/status/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&data_level=CAMPAIGN&query_ids=["{{query_id}}"]' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` # Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|list|object[]|The bid protection status information for your queried campaigns or ad groups.| ##|data_level|string|The data level.

Enum values:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: Campaign level.
  • `ADGROUP`: Ad group level.
| ##|query_id|string|The specific ID you queried.
  • When `data_level` is `CAMPAIGN`, this field represents an Upgraded Smart+ Campaign ID.
  • When `data_level` is `ADGROUP`, this field represents an Upgraded Smart+ Ad Group ID.
| ##|bid_protection_status|string|The current bid protection status for the campaign or ad group.

Enum values:
  • `ACTIVE`: Bid protection is active for the campaign or ad group. You’re eligible for ad credits when costs exceed your bid. You can query historical records through [/report/bid_protection/detail/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-bid-protection-history/v1.3).
  • `INVALID`: Bid protection is temporarily ineligible for the campaign or ad group because the campaign or ad group was paused or deleted within the first 3 days after creation.
  • `INACTIVE`: Bid protection is permanently ineligible for the campaign or ad group.
| ##|compensation_category|string|The bid protection compensation category.

Enum values:
  • `FULL_LIFE_CYCLE`: Full lifecycle compensation.[Bid Protection (Full Lifecycle)](https://ads.tiktok.com/resources/help/article/about-smart-plus-bid-protection) is the default solution, covering the campaign's entire duration.
  • `THREE_DAY`: Three-day compensation. Only bidding strategies that are currently unsupported in the Full Lifecycle version will use [Bid Protection (Learning Phase)](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/incentive-offer). This covers the first three full consecutive days from the day you activate the campaign.
| ``` ## Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "bid_protection_status": "ACTIVE", "compensation_category": "FULL_LIFE_CYCLE", "data_level": "CAMPAIGN", "query_id": "{{query_id}}" } ] } } (/code) ```
